paper.title_en: Cosmological collider signals of modular spontaneous CP breaking
paper.abstract_en: We consider a modular-invariant extension of the Standard Model. Assuming that the modulus is the inflaton, the CP-violating phases of the Yukawa couplings evolve during inflation. This dynamics favours a Higgs condensate, so that Standard Model fermions mediate a one-loop cosmological collider signal enhanced by chemical potentials. The effect appears too small for next-generation experiments. We provide precise expressions for Dirac fermions with chemical potentials in de Sitter.
